preregistered: 2026-10-07, before any GPU cohort run; not to be edited after results are seen
graph: real MaleCNS v1.0 with the v3 transmitter policy: experiment_registry.SharedGraph.load_for_dynamics(dynamics='v3')
dynamics: v3, fixed weights, default constants (no E_inh override)
initial_state: every fly at rest, exactly as a freshly built Brain

stimulus.kind: declared tonic drive on declared neurons (no encoder, no feedback)
stimulus.neurons_per_fly: n // 50, drawn without replacement by numpy.random.default_rng(seed).choice(n, n // 50, replace=False)
stimulus.k: fly index; every other neuron has drive 0.0

reference_comparison.call_pattern: step(drive, ticks=1) 200 times; full state compared after every tick
reference_comparison.spike_counts_and_raster: 0 mismatches, per fly, per neuron, per tick
reference_comparison.g_zero_handling: where the reference g is exactly 0.0 the candidate must satisfy |g| <= 1e-12 (absolute); elsewhere |g_gpu - g_ref| / |g_ref| <= 1e-6
reference_comparison.verdict_rule: the first tick at which any fly breaks any bound is reported and the comparison stops: FAIL. No later statistics can turn it into a PASS. No engine, tolerance or stimulus changes after a FAIL.
reference_comparison.precondition: the workload must spike (total spikes > 0) or the comparison is void

gpu_identity_checks.byte_identical_means: every array of read_state (v, g, refractory, queue, queue_count, counts, active, active_flag, nactive) plus cursor, total_spikes, sim_ms, and the per-call spike counts
gpu_identity_checks.batch_invariance: fly k at B=8 and at B=32 equals its B=1 run, ticks 200 as 10 calls of 20
gpu_identity_checks.cross_fly_isolation: B=8; fly 3 drive replaced by the seed 20261007 + 5000 pattern; flies != 3 byte-identical to the unperturbed run
gpu_identity_checks.resume: B=8; 120 ticks, read_state of every fly, write_state into a fresh engine, 80 more ticks == 200 uninterrupted
gpu_identity_checks.write_state_refusals: non-v3 dynamics, missing or extra key, wrong shape, wrong dtype
